name: andorfermichael/tripadvisor-scraper
what_it_holds: 36-star archived (read-only since ~Apr 2023) scraper that pulls hotel reviews across an entire city on TripAdvisor (examples: NYC, Paris, Vienna) into timestamped directories plus a 'totalizer' script to consolidate all reviews/hotel info into one output. Uses pickle-based caching keyed to a TripAdvisor location ID.
why_useful: City-level batch design is closer to what a review-velocity panel would need (one city -> many hotels -> many reviews) than single-hotel scrapers.
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
